titulo: One question for the quiet one at the table
caption:
One question for the quiet one at the table

"What do you think?" "Actually, I had an idea." One question to the quiet one at the table.

Some people only speak when someone makes room, and one invitation is usually all it takes.

For whoever turns to the quiet one and asks.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left turns toward a royal blue block figure on the right that looks down with narrowed eyes. A bubble says what do you think? The blue one opens its eyes wide and a bubble says I had an idea. The black one's eyes go wide and a bubble says go on, please! Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me asking the quiet one.
